svg.aria-label: A transit-map diagram of agent-bus. Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are stations on one line. A handoff runs from Claude Code to Codex, the finished work runs back to Claude Code to be checked, Codex claims a file so OpenCode stays out of it, and OpenCode's question about dropping a table runs to the last stop: you.
svg.title: agent-bus: your agents on one line, and you get off only for the decisions
svg.text: You get off only for the decisions.
One decision waits for you. The agents handled the rest.
No server. One bash script, jq, and a log in ~/.agents/bus/
